# Galmuri11 Hangul bitmaps

`galmuri11-hangul.js` holds the 11 x 11 bitmaps of every Hangul syllable and compatibility jamo from
[Galmuri](https://github.com/quiple/galmuri) 2.40.3 (npm `galmuri`), © 2019–2025 Lee Minseo, under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (no Reserved Font Name; full text in `fonts/Galmuri11-OFL.txt`, also bundled in the booth
page). The booth's 픽셀 font draws Hangul from it. Regenerate with `tools/fonts/galmuri_bitmap.py`.
